Changes in this Release
- security: quote primary key column names when building `nodeId`. Primary key column names were interpolated into the generated SQL unquoted, so a name needing quoting broke `nodeId` selection, and a name carrying a SQL fragment was executed in the querying role's context. See the security advisory GHSA-3xwc-rjxj-m99h.

Full changelog: https://github.com/supabase/pg_graphql/blob/master/docs/changelog.md

## What's Changed
* chore: pin actions to sha by @staaldraad in https://github.com/supabase/pg_graphql/pull/640
* fix: bump rand to a minimum version of 0.8.6 to fix a dependabot alert by @imor in https://github.com/supabase/pg_graphql/pull/643
* chore: bump pgrx to 0.19.2 and fix clippy warnings by @imor in https://github.com/supabase/pg_graphql/pull/645
* chore: bump version to 1.6.2 by @imor in https://github.com/supabase/pg_graphql/pull/648
* chore: use pgrx version 0.19.2 in release workflow by @i

Changes in this Release
- bugfix: Remove double NON_NULL wrapping on byPk argument types — fixes GraphiQL crashing with `Expected UUID! to be a GraphQL nullable type` when introspection is enabled (#635, closes #633)
- bugfix: Mixed introspection and data fields in the same query now return correct partial results (#631) 
- docs: Fix typo in configuration.md (#632)

After a user logs out, session tokens are now invalidated at all worker processes. Session validity is checked in the central database on each API request, throttled by the `refresh_time` configuration parameter.

`run_db_model.py` was importing `declarative_base` from the deprecated `sqlalchemy.ext.declarative` path. It now imports from `sqlalchemy.orm`, matching `config_db_model.py` and eliminating `MovedIn20Warning` on module load. Fixes [#5116](https://github.com/Ericsson/codechecker/issues/5116).
- **Remove redundant code and set database connection timeout**
- A redundant `psql`-based connectivity check in `PostgreSQLServer.connect()` was removed; the equivalent check already exists in `check_schema()`.

agentglass v0.23.2 — the in-app update accepts releases again

The in-app update only installs a version whose tag is signed with the pinned release key. The tags from v0.20.0 to v0.23.1 were annotated but not signed, so every install that updates from source refused them. This release is signed, and the release workflow now checks the signature before it publishes anything. Nothing else changes.
